interpretation: NPC win fractions in this paired deterministic benchmark, not any player's personal loss probability. IV/training curve is unchanged. Floor 45/50 and 95/100 are different difficulty strata; short rank references have only four seeds per case. Ordinary player has no items; no universal rank order can be inferred.

telemetry.activeTurns: unique public turns during each species field presence, summed across entries; not wall time and may overlap on a pivot turn
telemetry.firstImpressionAvailable: requests on first action of a new entry with base First Impression in legal actions
telemetry.completeEntryChains: actual First Impression → Emergency Exit → field return → actual First Impression; each return counted once
telemetry.switchLoop: voluntary A→B followed by B→A within two turns; forced replacements and U-turn receivers excluded
telemetry.typeRisk: largest type multiplier among public foe STAB types, not a claim about an unrevealed actual move
telemetry.zLegal: battle/decision-turn availability on the request; not every equipped carrier survives to act

decisions.guzma: 목표 난이도 달성 (검증 표본의 캡틴 상위~사천왕권)
decisions.item: Final Golisopite per user follow-up. Ordinary Sitrus control beats Life Orb/Assault Vest in total wins but remains below the intended band; the Mega trial improves total wins. Mega is gated by the existing floor rule and removes Emergency Exit after transformation.
decisions.rank: Relative benchmark placement, not a strict ordering against every captain/Elite or player team; confidence intervals and floor breakdowns are included.
decisions.causality: Before/ordinary combines roster/set/AI changes. Restored-v12 ablation holds the ordinary Guzma data and expert tier fixed. Final Mega adds the stone/ability/form and preserves the ordinary entry-loop evidence separately.
decisions.preservation: 224 other reviewed/runtime rows are checked directly against the requested commit, alongside all other Alola metadata, shared builds and the three existing trainer overrides. Historical preservation fixtures remain unchanged; their explicitly authorized Hau/Guzma rows are reconstructed for old checks, and their AI checksum checks the frozen v12 archive. New format opts in to Mega Golisopod without changing saved old formats.
